name: Kirateshwar Mahadev Temple
summary: Kirateshwar Mahadev — important living Shiva temple of West Sikkim.

mythology: Kirateshwar Mahadev Temple at Legship, Sikkim is dedicated to Lord Shiva (Kirateshwar), known especially for Sikkimese Shiva · Rangit river festival search. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Lord Shiva (Kirateshwar) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
